_info: Stock (standard) configuration of ONE engine, loaded automatically when this engine is selected and by the button 'Load stock configuration'. File name = engine id. 'chargers': a catalog id (string) or {"profile": {...}, "count": n} for a part that belongs to this engine only. Maps use the shared rpm axis [800,2000,3500,5000,6000,7000] and load axis [0,25,50,75,100] ([loadIdx][rpmIdx]). 'reference' holds a known factory power figure for later calibration.
name: Audi 4.2 FSI V8 (350 PS) - stock configuration
generated: ignition and fuel maps derived from the shared base maps: rpm axis stretched to this engine's redline, fuel scaled by displacement per cylinder, ignition for a naturally aspirated engine (low-load row, 0.1 deg retard per % load)

reference.standard: Rating in PS/kW as published, converted to mechanical hp with 1 hp = 1.01387 PS
reference.market: Europe/North America (as stated in the source)
reference.source: Audi of America 2008 A6 4.2 FSI quattro specs (84.5 x 92.8 mm, 4163 cc, 12.5:1, 350 hp at 6800 rpm, aluminum block and head, firing order 1-5-4-8-6-3-7-2); Audi AG V8 FSI service training (257 kW/350 bhp at 6800 rpm, 440 N·m at about 3500 rpm, 90 degree V); encycarpedia.com A6 4.2 FSI quattro 350
reference.notes: Estimated, not in the sources: connecting rod length (153.1 mm = 1.65 x stroke); redline 7500 rpm and limiter 7800 rpm; oil mass 7.1 kg (scaled from displacement). Stock fuel 'ultimate-102' is the lowest octane rating without knock in this simulation; it can differ from the real fuel requirement.
